note: Neutral, synthetic overlay shipped in public builds (build:swa, build:fabric) and used by tests. Contains no owner identity or real asset list. realAssets.ts uses this whenever the owner's gitignored real-assets.local.json is absent (production, CI, the test runner). Keep this contract-clean and ownerless. See docs/PRIVACY.md.
